response:
Great question!  Here’s how to make a pumpkin pie:

Ingredients:

1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
3/4 teaspoon baking powder
1 teaspoon baking soda
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon ground ginger
1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
1/4 teaspoon salt
1 cup diced cream of tartar
4 cups pumpkin puree
3 large eggs

Preparation:

In a medium bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and salt. 

In a large bowl, combine pumpkin puree and cream of tartar. Add eggs and whisk together.

Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until well blended. Do not over mix.

Pour the batter into a pie pan and sprinkle with pumpkin pie spice. 

Bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.  This pie should be set but still slightly wobbly.  (Your oven will vary, so keep an eye on it.  You can check by dipping a candy thermometer into the pie to see if it is actually warm.  A thermometer should read at least 200 degrees in my kitchen.) 

Allow cookies to cool completely on a wire rack.  Enjoy!

3 1/2 lb firm goat cheese
